provenance.what: Two live captures of the activity scanner's candidate set, used to correct the implied-active-TVL metric and re-derive its window (MIN/MAX_IMPLIED_ACTIVE_TVL) — audit finding M6 / batch B8.
provenance.code_path: fetchMeteoraPools() (server list pages) then getCachedMeteoraPools() (the module's own in-process cache of the SAME snapshot BEFORE the client JS pre-filter) — so `selected` IS the bot's own applyJsPreFilter decision and `pools` is the exact population it filtered.
provenance.anonymisation: pool address/name and every NON-protocol token mint+symbol replaced; EVERY numeric field verbatim; protocol mints (WSOL/USDC/USDT) kept as public repo constants (bot/scanner/pool-fetcher.ts).
provenance.why_two_captures: The candidate set is the top ~200 pools by 1h fee/TVL, so its size range moves between windows: capture C1 tops out at 339,001.97 USD real TVL, C2 at 1,614,887.72 USD. An upper bound derived from a single capture would re-introduce M6-style false rejections in a wider window, so the ceiling is derived from BOTH.
